Class ModelThreadCRUD

java.lang.Object
guiThreadCRUD.ModelThreadCRUD
public class ModelThreadCRUD extends Object

Title: ModelThreadCRUD Class.

Description: The model for the staff discussion thread CRUD page. This class performs the validation and database operations needed to create, update, delete, and display discussion threads. This model implements the core application behavior for Staff User Story S3: as a staff member, I can create, read, update, and delete discussion threads. Its thread-management behavior is validated primarily by the JUnit tests in FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.

Version:
1.00 2026-04-11 Initial version for staff discussion thread CRUD

  • Method Details

    • refreshThreadList

      protected static void refreshThreadList()

      Method: refreshThreadList()

      Description: This method reloads the current set of discussion threads from the database and repopulates the list view shown on the page. It also clears any prior status message so the refreshed view reflects the latest thread state.

      The database thread list used by this method is validated by FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.NormalTest01(), FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.NormalTest02(), and FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.NormalTest03().

    • performRefresh

      protected static void performRefresh()

      Method: performRefresh()

      Description: This method refreshes the thread list and then informs the user that the visible discussion thread list has been updated successfully.

      The refreshed list content depends on the same thread-list behavior validated by FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.NormalTest01(), FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.NormalTest02(), and FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.NormalTest03().

    • createThread

      protected static void createThread()

      Method: createThread()

      Description: This method reads the new discussion thread title entered by the staff user, validates it, and requests creation of the thread in the database. If creation succeeds, the visible list is refreshed and the status message reports success. If validation or database creation fails, an error is shown to the user.

      The database thread-creation behavior used here is validated by FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.NormalTest01() for successful creation and FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.RobustTest01() for duplicate-title rejection.

    • updateThread

      protected static void updateThread()

      Method: updateThread()

      Description: This method updates the title of the currently selected discussion thread using the replacement title entered by the staff user. The method verifies that a thread has been selected and that the new title is valid before requesting the update. If the update succeeds, the page is refreshed and the user is informed of success. Otherwise, an error is shown.

      The database thread-update behavior used here is validated by FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.NormalTest02() for successful update and FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.RobustTest03() for duplicate-title rejection.

    • deleteThread

      protected static void deleteThread()

      Method: deleteThread()

      Description: This method requests deletion of the currently selected discussion thread. It first checks that a thread is selected, then relies on the database rules to reject deletion of protected threads such as the default "General" thread or any thread that still contains posts. If the delete succeeds, the page is refreshed and the user is informed of success. Otherwise, an error is shown.

      The database thread-deletion behavior used here is validated by FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.NormalTest03() for successful deletion and FullStaffThreadCRUDTester.RobustTest02() for protection of the default "General" thread.
